data.text: God is known in Judah; his name is great in Israel.
data.subtitulo: For the music director. With stringed instruments. A psalm of Asaph. A song.

data.text: His shelter is in Salem, and his dwelling place in Zion.
There he shattered the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.
You are radiant, majestic beyond the mountains of prey.
The stouthearted have been plundered; they have sunk into sleep. None of the mighty warriors could use their hands.
data.titulo: The Armed and Mighty Brought Low

data.text: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse fell into deep sleep.
You, you are to be feared! Who can stand before you once your anger is aroused?
data.titulo: The Judgment That Saves the Humble

data.text: From heaven you made judgment heard; the earth feared and was still,
when God rose to judge, to save all the humble of the earth. Selah.
Surely human wrath will praise you; with the remainder of wrath you will gird yourself.
data.titulo: Honor the Lord before Whom Kings Tremble

data.text: Make vows to the LORD your God and fulfill them; let all who surround him bring gifts to the One who is to be feared.
He cuts off the spirit of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.
